                • Uday
                  4 out of 5 stars
                  Solid build, great cameras, speakers & performance. Minor early heating. No network issues
                  Reviewed in India on 15 March 2026
                  Colour: Awesome NavySize: 8GB + 128GB
                  Verified Purchase
                  Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
                  Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

                  I got the phone for ~23000. Its a good phone for this price, given that you get full One UI support. It came with One UI 7, after which I updated it to One UI 8, which is just fabulous. It has been 3 days since I got it, and I experienced slight heating when multiple apps were getting downloaded and updated. I also noticed the battery was draining faster than expected, though this can be because of the phone analyzing my usage. I hope it should be resolved as I continue using the phone.

                  The display is top notch, speakers are good (the phone has stereo speakers, which means the ear piece you use for calls is also used as media speaker), the screen size is on the larger size but not in negative terms.

                  Cameras are decent enough given the price. The phone feels solid and slightly heavy, the built quality is good. It has glass back, thus it feels premium to hold.

                  Fingerprint sensor is good too although you might feel sometimes that it takes a while to unlock the phone, by a very minute difference. Overall the looks of the phone are good.

                  For performance, you won't feel any issues for normal usage, it feels snappy with 120Hz refresh rate. Multiple apps open in background wont slow it down, although I noticed some frame drops here and there, but overall the performance will not disappoint you.

                  Network connectivity is solid, you get 5G where its available, there hasn't been any call connectivity issues till now.

                  I recently bought the Samsung Galaxy A35 5G from Amazon, and I’ve been extremely impressed with the overall experience. The delivery was quick, the packaging was secure, and the phone itself has exceeded my expectations.

                  Performance:

                  The A35 5G runs smoothly with everyday apps, multitasking, and even light gaming. The interface feels snappy and responsive thanks to Samsung’s optimization.

                  Display:

                  The Super AMOLED screen is absolutely beautiful—vibrant colors, deep blacks, and excellent brightness. Watching videos and scrolling through apps feels very smooth.

                  Camera:

                  The camera quality is great for the price. Photos come out crisp with natural colors, and the low-light performance is surprisingly solid.

                  Battery Life:

                  The battery easily lasts me a full day with moderate use. Fast charging is a huge plus.

                  Build Quality:

                  It has a sturdy, premium feel, and the design looks modern and clean. Definitely feels like more than a mid-range phone.

                  Overall, I’m extremely happy with my purchase. If you’re looking for a reliable, stylish, and feature-packed phone at a great value, the Samsung Galaxy A35 5G is an excellent choice. Highly recommended!
